correctness.rationale: Exactly six permutations of (1,2,4) at each of seven initial vertices give 42 ordinary Hom vertices; exactly three coordinate replacement edges per vertex give 63 edges. Direct common-neighbor arithmetic rules out all higher-dimensional cells. An independent exhaustive script checks all 105 Hom cells, every edge and neighborhood, the free order-three action, 41-edge connected spanning tree, local covering degree, 14 orbit vertices, 21 quotient edges, translated Fano (7,3,1) difference set and rational character. Connected graphs have wedge homotopy, and rational transfer yields 8 deck invariants plus 7 cyclotomic modules.

value.rationale: The smallest doubly regular tournament supplies a canonical directed reconfiguration complex. The precise regular threefold covering of the Fano Levi/Heawood graph is a motivated structural identification connecting two independently natural finite objects, and its rational homology deck character is not fixed by the raw face counts. Provides an exact geometric explanation for all 22 integral loops; no arbitrary slicing or unsupported all-orders extrapolation.
